conditions.evidence: a primary diagnosis of an anxiety disorder
conditions.label: anxiety disorder

modalities.evidence: structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data
behavioral responses from a novel mobile application

output.population: Youth ages 8–18 meeting criteria for an anxiety disorder, DMDD, or ADHD, plus youth with clinically-significant irritability and youth with no psychiatric diagnosis; reported ages 8.25–20.22
output.summary: Youth with anxiety disorders, disruptive mood dysregulation disorder, ADHD, irritability, or no psychiatric diagnosis completed neuropsychological tests and a mobile inhibitory-control app, alongside structural and functional MRI and clinical symptom ratings.
